intro: Sleep deeper with Eleganza mattress. Its soft foam cradles you, anti-sag layers hold firm for lasting support, and breathable fabric keeps you cool through every season.

features.title: Support that adapts with Euro-top design
features.text: Experience unparalleled comfort with the Euro Top Design, crafted to provide an extra layer of plushness. Its luxurious cushioning enhances support and softness, ensuring a restful and rejuvenating sleep experience every night.

features.title: Stay cool with breathable fabric comfort
features.text: Stay cool and comfortable! High-quality knitted fabric allows for better airflow, keeping your mattress fresh through the night.

features.title: Prevents sagging for lasting comfort
features.text: Tired of furniture that loses shape? This piece is designed to stay just as supportive and comfortable, no matter how often you use it.

features.title: Foam core that supports and comforts
features.text: Our bonded foam core works quietly beneath you, maintaining proper spinal alignment to support healthier posture while you sleep.

features.title: Sized to match your bed seamlessly
features.text: Get a flawless fit every time with our made-to-measure dimensions, designed to hug your bed seamlessly and give your bedroom a polished, tailored look.

name: Elegenza Single Bed Foam Mattress 75 X 30 X 8 Inches
